q: One ORS packet is dissolved in:
e: 1 litre of clean (boiled and cooled) water.

q: A child vomits while taking ORS. You should:
o: Wait 10 minutes and give more slowly

q: The intraosseous needle is inserted in the:
o: Proximal tibia, medial, below the tuberosity
e: Flat medial surface of the proximal tibia.

q: The length of a nasogastric tube is measured from:
A chest X-ray showing a boot-shaped heart suggests:
A MUAC reading of 11 cm in a 2-year-old means:
o: Cannot be used at this age
